en.headline: Manpower panel flags rise in youth unemployment
en.dek: Seasonally adjusted unemployment edged up to 3.8 percent in June to August, and officials briefed the panel on a 30,000-place youth jobs scheme.
body: The Human Resources Planning Commission noted on Monday that youth unemployment deserved attention, after the seasonally adjusted jobless rate rose from 3.7 percent in May to July to 3.8 percent in June to August.

Chief Secretary Chan Kwok-ki chaired the seventh meeting of the commission's fourth term, the government said. Members understood that higher unemployment and youth joblessness were structural problems facing most advanced economies, and that Hong Kong was not an exception.

The commission noted that the government was continuing to put resources into education and skills training. This year's Policy Address includes a two-year scheme of 30,000 jobs and internships for young people. The Labour Department will also launch an online window, Youth Employment Connect, to make training and job-support information easier to find. Members were told that continued local economic growth was expected to keep supporting the labour market.

The Labour and Welfare Bureau briefed the commission on the results of a mid-term update to the manpower projection. The government said it would draw up measures from that update, including stronger local training and refinements to talent-admission schemes. The bureau is about to start a new review of the Talent List and will look at adding more categories tied to the use of artificial intelligence, taking account of the latest industry and manpower figures in the report.

zh.headline: 人力規劃委員會關注青年失業 失業率升至3.8%
zh.dek: 經季節性調整的失業率由5至7月的3.7%升至6至8月的3.8%，官員向委員會簡介三萬個青年職位及實習計劃。
body: 人力資源規劃委員會星期一指出，青年失業情況值得關注。經季節性調整的失業率，由今年5月至7月的3.7%，微升至6月至8月的3.8%。
政府說，政務司司長陳國基主持第四屆委員會第七次會議。委員理解，失業率上升和青年就業是大部分先進經濟體面對的結構性問題，香港亦不例外。
委員會備悉，政府持續投放資源於教育和技能培訓。今年《施政報告》推出為期兩年的三萬個青年職位及實習計劃。勞工處將推出「青年就業通」網上服務窗口，方便青年查找培訓和就業支援資訊。委員獲告知，本地經濟持續增長，預料會繼續支持整體勞工市場。
勞工及福利局向委員簡介「人力推算中期更新」結果。政府說，會按更新結果制定措施，包括加強本地培訓和優化輸入人才安排。局方即將展開新一輪「人才清單」檢討，並會參考報告所載行業發展和人力需求，加入更多與人工智能應用相關的人才類別。
